title: 4 Days of claude opus, and an ambitious idea i've had for a while and i've created MARROW
author: Defiant_Event5148
selftext: a demo of a hack n slash/open world game concept i've had for a while! made this demo in under 4 days and curious what you guys thoughts are!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Defiant_Event5148 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: fhtiek
comments.body:
I am having a very hard time following combat, the weapon animations are doing a bad job of clearly showing arc and damage area and seem to be drawing overlapping trails over each other. The full screen flashes are not helping either 

The run animation also looks really messy. Evironments look cool but i can tell the game feel is not it from this short clip alone.

Moment to moment game feel is the most important part of an action game like this and its not even close. I think you need to take a hard look at those systems and polish the hell out of them

comments.author: PM_Me_Those_
comments.body: Well it does show that you made it in 4 days. Not the worst thing I've ever seen but the fact you released it in this state really makes anything you did feel cheap. This is nowhere near a finished product. Is this just a proof of concept for you? Nobody is going to want to play it.

replies.author: InsectDelicious4503
replies.body: Bro nobody said it was a finished product. I think this is pretty damn promising for only 4 days in.

comments.author: ffktiv
comments.body: I like some unknown void worlds with mega structures. Nice.
